dog.description_text: Rusty is a very handsome big guy with a story to tell. After being found alone in an industrial area, he is understandably a little fearful in the care center, but he is slowly warming up to staff and beginning to enjoy treats and affection. Rusty spends much of his day relaxing on his cozy Kuranda bed and taking in the comforts around him. With a little patience, kindness, and understanding, Rusty has so much potential to blossom.
